title: Git's secret diary
concept: git reflog brings back a lost commit

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: A commit seems lost! Use git reflog to find its hash, then cherry-pick it or reset to it.

hints: A commit seems to have vanished. Where can you find it?
`git reflog` shows every place HEAD has been, even after a reset.
Answer the question about using reflog to recover work.

questions.explanation: Reflog is a diary of everywhere you've been.

recap: git reflog shows everywhere HEAD has been, so you can recover lost commits.
